name: MillionVerifier
summary: Real-time email verification with a quality grade, result code, role and free-provider flags, and a credit balance check.

api_key.description: a MillionVerifier API key (API page of your MillionVerifier dashboard)

notes: The key goes in the api query parameter. The docs publish a test key, API_KEY_FOR_TEST, that returns random results.
The bulk file API (upload, fileinfo, filelist, download, stop, delete) is on another host, bulkapi.millionverifier.com, and takes the key as 'key'; it is not in this entry.
Failures such as a bad key or missing email still come back with HTTP 200 and a message in the error field.

endpoints.name: Verify one email
endpoints.summary: Result (ok, catch_all, unknown, error, disposable, invalid), quality (good, bad, risky), subresult, role and free flags, and remaining credits.

email.description: The address to verify; encode special characters.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the recipient server, 2 to 60 (default 20).

notes: The response includes credits, the balance left after the call.

endpoints.name: Get remaining credits
endpoints.summary: Remaining verification credits, plus renewing credits and the plan number.
